01-cover.jpg.en: One heart. Three ways to say I love you.

02-the-beginning.jpg.en: It starts with a flutter: a small heart blooming inside a larger one.
02-the-beginning.jpg.zh: 一切始于那一瞬的心动，小小的心，在更大的心里绽放。

03-the-connection.jpg.en: Gold and white gold, woven together. Two become one, always holding on.
03-the-connection.jpg.zh: 黄金与白金交织，两个人成为一体，彼此相守。

04-the-everlasting.jpg.en: Flowing lines with no end, built to last as long as the promise.
04-the-everlasting.jpg.zh: 流线延绵不绝，如誓言般恒久。

05-closing.jpg.en: Every love story begins with a heart.
05-closing.jpg.zh: 每一段爱情，都从一颗心开始。
